reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact native source, enlarged source page 11 and targeted source panel/note crops, complete unchanged native RGBA raw, targeted native-resolution returned-note and frame crops, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa mascot reference

remaining_reasons: The source note has two compact upper gray-mark rows and no metal fastener at its upper-right corner. The return adds a distinct dark metal pin/clip there and expands the marks into three rows. Remove the invented clip and third row, restoring only the source-scale compact two-row footprint and largely blank lower paper.

The source's real tilted outer photo frame is dark. The returned native frame crop shows a conspicuously pale beige outer frame instead. Restore the dark frame appearance while retaining its complete geometry and the opaque photographic backplate.
entries.positive_observation: The yellow mascot retains a near-frontal upright pose, forward gaze and restrained closed-mouth half-smile. The dark olive cap has a shiny black visor, gold piping/cord and two separated gold front emblems; dark eyebrows remain, with no glasses, moustache or beard. The dark olive uniform retains gold shoulder braid, two bright red collar patches with pale/gold detailing and one black-and-silver cross at the throat. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar without a stalk or clipping. The card/note geometry, opaque grey-beige photographic backing and right-edge tab remain, and full white/cyan comparisons show no visible holes, lost backing or working-matte ring. These positives do not offset the added note content and frame-color replacement.
entries.visible_limitations: Fine cap/collar embroidery, the tiny neck-cross detail and note lettering are not reliably readable at 65x67; none is an additional rejection reason. The added metal clip, two-to-three note-row change and dark-to-pale frame change are all clearly visible.
